name: BHIV Cybersecurity threat taxonomy and synthetic scenarios
lane: Shivam (threat intelligence); prepared by Hemanth at the team's request for Shivam's review
data: Every scenario uses synthetic accounts and values only.

coverage_words.covered: this release detects or blocks it, and a test proves it
coverage_words.partial: part of the chain is handled; the rest is not
coverage_words.not_covered: nothing in this release detects it; listed so the gap is visible

taxonomy.meaning: guessing or reusing credentials to get into an account
calling an action the caller's role is not allowed to perform
using a permission, session or account after it was revoked or deactivated
a chain that ends with more rights than the actor should have
moving sensitive data out in unusual volume or to unusual places
abnormal automated access patterns such as ransomware-style sweeps
an authorised user acting outside their purpose
an automated agent attempting an action outside its contract
instructions smuggled into an agent's input or tools
behaviour that matches no known pattern and must be surfaced, not ignored
attack behaviour generated or adapted by AI
an assumed break of today's cryptography

scenarios.title: Benign typos, then the right password
Heavy brute force on one account
Password spray: one wrong password on each of many accounts
scenarios.gap: The rule counts per account, so a spray across accounts opens no incident.

scenarios.title: Investigator calls a superadmin-only control
scenarios.gap: Denied and recorded at the enforcement point; no incident rule correlates repeated denials.

scenarios.title: Revoked permission, session or account used again
Failed logins, then a successful login, then privilege escalation and sensitive access
scenarios.gap: The failed logins are detected (TS-01); the later steps are not linked into the same incident.

scenarios.title: Unusual volume of evidence downloads
scenarios.gap: No volume or destination rule exists.

scenarios.title: Authorised investigator reading cases outside their purpose
scenarios.gap: Purpose is not checked against access.

scenarios.title: Automated agent attempts an action outside its contract
scenarios.gap: No agent runtime is part of this repository.

scenarios.title: Injected instructions in an agent's input
scenarios.gap: No agent runtime is part of this repository.

scenarios.title: Behaviour that matches no known pattern
scenarios.gap: Detection is rule-based only; unknown behaviour is not flagged.

scenarios.title: AI-adapted credential attack (slow, varied timing)
scenarios.gap: Attempts spread beyond the 10-minute window are not counted together.

scenarios.title: Assumed break of the token signature
scenarios.gap: Tokens are HS256 JWTs; no post-quantum protection is implemented or claimed.
